Maya: Quick repro for a bundler -> edge failure with the JS SDK. Bundled app throws 'ReferenceError: require is not defined' only on Vercel Edge. Local Node ESM fine.
Ethan: Steps?
Maya: Minimal:
1) app has \"type\": \"module\"
2) SDK package has exports: { \"import\": \"dist/index.mjs\", \"require\": \"dist/index.cjs\" }
3) build with Vite (rollup resolver) -> deploy to Edge
Result: bundle resolves SDK to dist/index.cjs -> runtime crashes (require missing).
Ravi: Sounds like resolve.mainFields picked the CJS path. Did the build log show node-resolve preferring main?
Maya: Yes: \"preferring 'main' for redwood-inference -> /node_modules/redwood-inference/dist/index.cjs\"
Ethan: Workarounds: force resolver to prefer module/import. For Vite: 
resolve: { mainFields: ['module','main'] }
For webpack: set resolve.mainFields likewise.
Ravi: Longer term: SDK should add exports.browser or a browser ESM entry so bundlers targeting web/edge pick the right file. Also avoid sideEffects:false if it causes tree-shaking of runtime.
Maya: Opening issue with a tiny repro repo and logs now. Assigning @eng-devex to review packaging + docs. ci-bot: build job failed reproducer: https://ci.example.com/5678 - failing with require is not defined
Ethan: Add CI bundle tests (vite/rollup/webpack) that run output in node --input-type=module to catch this.
Maya: Will add example and PR.
